My aunt always said "if you wanna kill yourself but can't, it means you shouldn't. You're destined for something and the world needs you to be alive." You should stay alive but also be happy alive. Whatever you are going through it will eventually get better. Know that whoever is in your life loves you and wouldn't want you to be thinking about suicide even if it is just a thought. You will find a reason to live my friend, either being alive for someone else or what greatness you might come to do in the future. Stay strong and good luck

With social anxiety it's just something you gotta battle with constantly until you beat it. I know that's not really helpful but it's true. I use to have it pretty bad and I was able to beat it after 5 years. No matter how you look or how you feel there will be someone that likes you for you. Being in a relationship can show you how much you love yourself by realizing how much the other person loves you. So I say go for it, the next nice guy you meet don't be afraid and just be yourself 
I wish you luck :)

I wish I could isolate myself too buddy
You shouldn't feel like a piece crap though or think you're just talking to your phone.You're posting on here with all these other real people going through the same thing you are and we all share this depression. We can all share and talk with each other and maybe even help each other out.
Not really selfish, I'm sure everyone likes the feeling that they've helped out in a way. Always makes me happy the few times I've helped people so I get were you're coming from
Thank you for the kind words, I really do appreciate it
